geometry_semantics: Real per-frame Waymo vehicle-box XY footprint sampled on an independently measured SGCM road plane; same fixed world queries tested in all49 frames. Boxes define diagnostic patches only, never training masks or initialization.
exposure_semantics: In FRONT FOV, outside reviewed A/B/native-SAM vehicle mask union and not occluded by any actual vehicle OBB along camera segment. This is a ground-plane exposure opportunity, not proof of photometric/semantic visibility or clean-road ground truth.
lidar_semantics: Actual original LiDAR within0.15m measured plane, outside actual vehicle boxes; ground-query XY support radius0.25m, unique source-frame counts. Sparse physical support is not RGB truth.
limitations: Planar-road approximation; masks/3D boxes and temporal alignment have finite error.
Non-vehicle occluders are not explicitly ray-tested; road query range restricted to the actual traffic lanes.
At least one unmasked projection is not a quality pass; shadows and limited view diversity remain.
Data missing after the49-frame window is not used or silently added.

silhouette_source.semantics: Actual body-mask pixels in raw128 are back-projected onto the measured road plane, then fixed world positions are tested in all training frames. Wider199 uses actual native calibration/ego/3D boxes only: box-only candidate exposure is an optimistic upper bound, not confirmed clean road.
silhouette_source.pseudo_reference: Median actual RGB of projected queries with >=3 non-vehicle exposure opportunities. Plane/visibility/shadow errors remain; not vehicle-free ground truth.
